items.title: Mercury默认无令牌致未授权RCE
items.summary_zh: 默认无令牌部署下，未授权攻击者可创建Jupyter内核并发送execute_request执行任意Python
items.repro_note: 未授权创建kernel并发送execute_request执行Python
items.description: Mercury is a Python framework for sharing Jupyter notebooks as web applications and dashboards. Prior to 3.2.6, default tokenless deployments allow anonymous clients to create Jupyter kernels and send execute_request messages containing arbitrary Python. The endpoint blocklist does not cover /api/kernels, and the websocket wrapper previously tracked idle activity without authorizing executable messages. This issue is fixed in version 3.2.6.

items.title: Mercury终端API绕过致未授权RCE
items.summary_zh: 未授权攻击者经/api/terminals绕过匿名黑名单，获得Jupyter交互式系统shell
items.action_zh: 暂无官方修复信息；禁用匿名终端并限制/api/terminals
items.repro_note: 未授权请求/api/terminals进入Jupyter终端API；需目标可达
items.impact_scope: Notebook应用框架，可能暴露公网
items.description: Requests to /api/terminals therefore bypass the anonymous endpoint blocklist and reach Jupyter Server's terminal API. An unauthenticated attacker can use the resulting interactive operating-system shell to execute commands and access data available to the Mercury process.

items.title: CheckCle缺失授权可读写删记录
items.title_zh: CheckCle缺失授权可读写删记录
items.summary_zh: 未授权攻击者查询PocketBase记录接口，窃取密钥、篡改状态页并删除监控数据
items.action_zh: 暂无官方修复信息；配置集合API规则并限制访问
items.impact_scope: 监控平台，常暴露内网或公网
items.description: CheckCle through 1.6.0 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read, modify and delete records because shipped PocketBase collections use empty API rules. Attackers can query /api/collections/<name>/records endpoints to steal server_token values and alert_configurations secrets, disable alerting, alter status pages, or delete monitoring data.

items.title: FlyCms默认凭据致超管接管
items.summary_zh: 未授权攻击者用默认flycms/admin123登录，仅需验证码即可接管站点
items.action_zh: 暂无官方修复信息；修改默认密码并限制登录
items.description: FlyCms through commit edfdf724 contains a default credentials vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to gain super administrator access via the flycms account with password admin123. Attackers can log in through POST /api/auth/login, solving only the image captcha, to obtain full control of site content, users and configuration.

items.title: Camunda表达式注入可绕过限制
items.title_zh: Camunda表达式注入可绕过限制
items.summary_zh: 已认证用户通过TaskQueryDto的orQueries子查询注入表达式，可能造成命令执行
items.repro_note: 认证后向TaskQueryDto.orQueries注入子查询表达式
items.impact_scope: 工作流引擎，内网核心业务
items.description: Camunda 7.24.0 before 7.24.14 and 7.23.0 before 7.23.17 contains an expression injection vulnerability where AdhocQueryValidator.validate() fails to check sub-query expression maps within the orQueries field exposed by TaskQueryDto, allowing authenticated users to bypass the enableExpressionsInAdhocQueries restriction.
